description: Recheck possible tax-reduction routes against current retained property records and a few owner-reported categories. Returns research and next questions; answers never establish eligibility, verified evidence, savings, owner authority, payment or filing readiness. Do not send exact income, ages, identifiers, documents or a caller-supplied audit. For a property audit or a request to find tax-reduction routes, review opportunity_screen before concluding. A weak or held comparable-property analysis does not rule out independent relief, record corrections or billing research. Ask the next relevant unanswered targeted_questions item one at a time; use available_questions for relevant follow-ups. Accept none, not sure or skip, and do not repeat answered or skipped questions in this conversation unless the user changes the facts. After an answer, call recheck_property_opportunities for the same selected property and county with the accumulated explicit owner_answers and skipped_question_ids. Rechecks are stateless: resend still-applicable prior answers, preserve explicit false and empty arrays, and omit unknown or skipped fields instead of sending null or inventing a negative answer. Resend stable skipped_question_ids until the user supplies an answer or asks to revisit the question. Skips suppress prompts only and leave requirements unresolved. Do not transfer property-specific answers or skips to another property. When the user is done or skips the remaining questions, summarize supported research routes and missing evidence without treating unknowns as a denial. For a fact-only lookup, answer the requested fact and offer relevant screening without requiring an unrelated intake. Owner answers do not verify eligibility, savings, authority, payment or filing readiness.

county_key.description: Optional exact registered county adapter key, such as hamilton. Restricts lookup to that county and avoids unrelated county scans; conflicting explicit prefixes are rejected.

skipped_question_ids.description: Stable question IDs explicitly skipped in this same property conversation. Resend them with accumulated answers. Skips suppress prompts only; facts and eligibility remain unresolved.

name: recheck_property_opportunities
